'''''Twin Crossroads''''' is an upcoming [[canon]] adult novel that takes place between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Episode VII: The Force Awakens'']], and will be written by [[Beth Revis]] and published in hardcover by [[Random House Worlds]] on [[April 6]], [[2027]].<ref name="Reveal" /> It was first listed on the Penguin Random House website on [[July 18]], [[2026]]<ref name="Penguin" /> and was officially announced at the Random House Worlds panel at San Diego Comic-Con on [[July 24]], [[2026]].<ref name="Reveal" /> It will follow [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] as they find out more about their [[parent]]s after the events of ''Return of the Jedi'' on [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Reveal" /> 

''Twin Crossroads'' picks up right after the events of Beth Revis's prior novel ''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]'', and will bridge the gap between Leia and [[Han Solo]]'s wedding and Leia's abandoning of her Jedi training as seen in [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="Reveal" /> The story of ''Twin Crossroads'' was one that has been in the works at Random House for quite some time, and was originally titled ''Legacy'' before it was decided that the title better fit [[Madeleine Roux]]'s [[Legacy (novel)|novel]] about Leia and [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]. The events of ''Legacy'' have significant roots in the events of ''Twin Crossroads'', though Roux was unaware of the other novel's existence while she finished ''Legacy''.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|username=anakinsbbygirl|url=status/2080757423498023384|name=courtney / sdcc day|date=2026-07-24}}</ref>
